title: A warm welcome at Hearth Hamlet

setting.mapIntent: An isolated, reachable welcome yard built with existing meadow assets and manual scene dialogue.
placementConstraints: Do not place actors on water or solid building footprints
Keep the chest reachable from the yard spawn

participants.startingSituation: At the cottage entrance, standing still.
Walking in from the yard spawn.

uses.purpose: Show a short, manually advanced line from each existing map speaker.
Use the existing validated interaction/action flow for authored scene dialogue.
Use the already-authored chest interaction and reward as an optional nearby activity.
Keep the existing chest appearance; no new art or behavior is requested.

beats.intent: Wren greets the player and points out that the chest was left for travelers.
beats.speaker: healer-wren
beats.text: The chest holds your road supplies.

beats.intent: The villager warmly confirms that Wren keeps the yard open.
beats.speaker: player

beats.intent: The player may walk to the existing chest and interact with it.
beats.interactionIntent: Open the yard chest using the current chest interaction.
beats.expectedResult: The existing pack reward is granted once and its milestone persists after reload.

beats.intent: The conversation ends; the player remains free to explore the yard.
beats.expectedResult: No one is moved automatically and the scene does not block normal controls.

completion: Both dialogue lines can be read and manually advanced, the player can reach the chest, and the chest's existing reward is awarded at most once across save and reload.

canonicalFacts.statement: Healer Wren welcomes travelers and keeps supplies in the yard chest.

pendingThreads: The player may ask Wren about the road in a later scene.

sceneBrief.playerPurpose: Learn that this cottage is a safe stopping place and find supplies for the road.

consequence.description: Wren explicitly offers the yard supplies; the player can claim them once before leaving.

sceneBrief.setup: A traveler enters the cottage yard and meets its host.
sceneBrief.action: Walk to Wren, read the welcome and collect the offered supplies if desired.
sceneBrief.payoff: The host establishes a friendly place and the player receives useful supplies, rather than an unrelated test chest.
sceneBrief.continuityState: Wren welcomes travelers; existing chest state persists. No new mystery or mandatory relationship change.
